result.summary: 本文旨在寻找最简单的测试时扩展方法并实现强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了包含 1,000 个问题的数据集 s1K，并提出预算强制（budget forcing）来控制测试时计算量 [S1.p2]。在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上微调后，s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%，并通过预算强制将 AIME24 性能从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。作者开源了模型、数据和代码 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，最简单的实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但缺乏公开的简单方法 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
the viability of this paradigm was recently validated by OpenAI o1
none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior

method.text: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；二是预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束符或追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。核心思想是用极少量样本进行监督微调，并在测试时通过简单干预控制计算量 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
If the model generates more thinking tokens than a desired limit, we forcefully end the thinking process by appending an end-of-thinking token delimiter.
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and instead append “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace to encourage more exploration.

experiments.text: 论文在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上使用 s1K 进行监督微调，训练在 16 块 H100 GPU 上耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。评估使用三个推理基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），采用温度 0 的贪婪解码，测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外还进行了数据消融（比较随机选择、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K 等）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件控制、拒绝采样等） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B
Finetuning took 26 minutes on 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with PyTorch FSDP.
We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty.
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics.
we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1).
Here we test the importance of combining them and the overall efficacy of our selection.
In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%（MATH 和 AIME24） [abstract]。通过预算强制，s1-32B 在 AIME24 上从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。数据消融表明，联合使用质量、难度、多样性准则至关重要，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致性能显著下降（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全量 59K 样本相比 1K 选择并未带来实质提升 [S1.p3]。在测试时扩展方法中，预算强制提供了完美的控制性、良好的扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
scaling s1-32B with budget forcing allows extrapolating beyond its performance without test-time intervention: from 50% to 57% on AIME24
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.

limitations.text: 作者指出预算强制在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型的上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
